leadText:
Len (Japanese: コウジ Kōji) is a character of the day who appeared in Stage Fight!.

Len was a member of the Pokémon Showboat Crew along with Roger, Kay, and . His main role in the Pokémon show was voicing . When boarded their boat and held their Pokémon captive, he helped trick Team Rocket into believing all of the Pokémon knew how to talk.
